title: Identity access token v1
description: RS256 JWT (typ at+jwt) bound to an OAuth grant, session, client and resource audience. Cryptographic verification does not check revocation; introspection additionally checks the active grant/session/principal and current client policy.

scope.description: Space-delimited scopes allowed for the token audience.

amr.description: Methods derived from the recorded authentication. A passwordless session does not claim pwd. AMR alone does not establish a fresh step-up or an assurance level.

aud.description: Target runtime audience, for example nvbes-account-service.

sid.description: Session bound to this access token.

auth_time.description: Primary authentication UTC epoch seconds; issuing another token does not refresh this time.

step_up_expires_at.description: Consumers requiring step-up must check freshness at the time of the operation, even if the access token has not expired.
